subject: Spirit Temple
text: Using the Lens of Truth in the staircase reveals two chests that both contain a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: In this staircase, use the Lens of Truth to see two chests which both contain a RECOVERY HEART.

subject: Colossus's left hand
text: A chest on the Colossus's left hand contains the Mirror Shield.

evidence.quote: You're now on the Colossus's left hand. Open the chest for a MIRROR SHIELD, allowing you to reflect light and other stuff.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Reflecting light onto the sun face in the Armos room opens a door to a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Angle your shield so that the light will hit the sun face...This'll open the door here. Enter to find a chest with a SMALL KEY.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Stepping on the platform switch lowers the fire surrounding the chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Step on it to lower the fire surrounding the chest. Open it for the BOSS KEY, then exit this room.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Using the Mirror Shield to burn away the sun face in the Lizalfos section causes a chest containing Bombs to appear.

evidence.quote: Head back to the Lizalfos section, and use the Mirror Shield to burn away the sun face. A chest will appear that contains BOMBS.

subject: Armos switch puzzle
text: To solve the pressure switch puzzle, shoot the Armos across from the switch with the Bow so it hops onto the switch.

evidence.quote: To solve this puzzle, head to the right door, aim your Bow towards the Armos across from the switch. Shoot it and it will hop towards you. When it's on the switch, enter the door quickly.

subject: Twinrova, Sorceress Sisters
text: In phase one of the Twinrova fight, reflect each sister's elemental beam with the Mirror Shield toward the opposite sister.

evidence.quote: In order to damage these witches, you must reflect their spells with the Mirror Shield and point it toward the other witch.

subject: Twinrova, Sorceress Sisters
text: In phase two, absorb three projectiles of the same element with the Mirror Shield to fire a beam that stuns Twinrova.

evidence.quote: You must absorb three projectiles OF THE SAME ELEMENT...Once you do, you'll fire a beam of that element, stunning her.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Defeating the boss of the Spirit Temple rewards a Heart Container.

evidence.quote: Watch the funny cutscene, then find the HEART CONTAINER.

subject: Nabooru
text: Nabooru reveals she is a Sage of the Spirit Temple and awards the Spirit Medallion.

evidence.quote: After revealing that Nabooru is indeed a Sage of the Spirit Temple, she gives you the SPIRIT MEDALLION.

subject: Desert Colossus
text: Lifting the white rock to the left of the Spirit Temple reveals a Secret Cave with Business Scrubs selling Green Potions and Red Potions.

evidence.quote: Right where you appear, you should see a white rock on the left of the screen. Head over there and lift it up to find a Secret Cave, where you'll find Business Scrubs selling Green Potions and Red Potions.

subject: Zora's Fountain
text: Lifting the white boulder on the far right ledge in Zora's Fountain reveals a hole leading to the 100th Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In here, head for the ledge far to the right and lift the white boulder to reveal a hole...At the top is the FINAL Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 100 out of 100)

subject: Zelda
text: In the Temple of Time, Zelda reveals herself and gives Link the Light Arrows before being captured by Ganondorf.

evidence.quote: Ganondorf captures her after she gives you the LIGHT ARROWS.

subject: Ganon's Castle
text: A chest in the Shadow trial of Ganon's Castle contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: First, you can Longshot to the chest for a BLUE RUPEE, if you want.

subject: Ganon's Castle
text: Stepping on a switch in the Shadow trial causes a large treasure chest to fall containing the Golden Gauntlets.

evidence.quote: Once on the next platform, go down the platforms to the right and step on a switch to make a large treasure chest fall down. Longshot to it if the platforms are gone, and open it for the GOLDEN GAUNTLETS.

subject: Great Fairy of Courage
text: Lifting the large black stone outside Ganon's Castle leads to the Great Fairy of Courage, who doubles Link's defense when Zelda's Lullaby is played.

evidence.quote: Head inside to find the Great Fairy of Courage. Wake her with the Lullaby and she'll double your defense.

subject: Ganon's Castle
text: In the Spirit trial of Ganon's Castle, hitting the crystal switch with a spin slash causes a chest with Bombchus to drop.

evidence.quote: Kill the Torch Slugs, and hit the crystal switch with a basic spin slash (rotate Control Stick then press B) to make a chest fall down. Open it for some BOMBCHUs.

subject: Ganon's Castle
text: In the Light trial of Ganon's Castle, killing the Skulltula and bats reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Killing them all will make a chest appear. Ignore the others, as they're trapped ones. Open the one that appeared to get a SMALL KEY.

subject: Ganon's Castle
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce mark in the Light trial makes a chest appear with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce mark to make another chest appear with a SMALL KEY.

subject: Ganon's Castle
text: In the Water trial block puzzle, push the farther block into the hole, then push the other block right, up, and left to slide it under the red ice within 2 minutes.

evidence.quote: In here, you have 2 minutes to get this puzzle figured out. First, push the further block into the hole. Next, push the other block right (in the perspective from entering the room) then up, then left to make it slide under the red ice.

subject: Ganon's Castle
text: In the Forest trial of Ganon's Castle, defeating the Wolfos causes a chest to appear containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: In here, kill the Wolfos to make a chest appear containing a BLUE RUPEE.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: After collecting 100 Gold Skulltulas, returning to Kakariko Village rewards a Huge Rupee worth 200 Rupees, which can be received infinitely.

evidence.quote: At the top is the FINAL Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 100 out of 100)...Once you have that, head to Kakariko Village and get your last prize: a HUGE RUPEE. ...ALL THAT WORK FOR 200 RUPEES? AGH! *mumbles* Though...you can return there and he'll give you infinite Huge Rupees.
